plugins.name: recall
plugins.description: Automatic branch-aware recall system with layered overlays, conditional topic loading, and merge promotion.

plugins.name: ntfy
plugins.description: ntfy.sh push notifications when the agent asks a question. Off by default; toggle per-session with /ntfy-on and /ntfy-off.

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Enforces safe agent behavior by blocking or limiting tool usage patterns that degrade session quality.

plugins.name: herdr-kit
plugins.description: Herdr agent tools: checkpoint-and-relaunch a running claude/pi/codex agent in place (including self-rotation via a detached daemon), plus non-blocking async inter-agent messaging.
